run_m4t_finetune: run the finetune script with train and eval dataset manifests for seamlessM4T models
init_finetune_parser: init an argparse parser for M4T finetuning with dataset paths, model name, and training hyperparameters
configure_speech_to_text_finetune: configure speech-to-text finetune mode with batch size, learning rate, and early stopping patience
build_finetune_params: build FinetuneParams with model name, device, dtype, batch sizes, epochs, and evaluation steps
run_unity_finetune: run UnitYFinetune with model, finetune params, train and eval data loaders, and optional frozen modules
